conditions-checklist.name: Conditions Checklist
conditions-checklist.description: Build a conditions checklist from their conditions sheet: loan number, condition text, PTD/PTF/suspense as they coded it, and status.

loan-file-index.name: Loan File Index
loan-file-index.description: Index PDFs they stored: application, ID (minimum necessary), income, assets, VOE, contract, and other imaged items as present versus missing.

missing-docs.name: Missing Docs
missing-docs.description: Compare their document-folder index to the conditions sheet and list named items that are missing, cut off, or undated.

date-stamps.name: Date Stamps
date-stamps.description: Build a date-file pack from their calendar and document-folder index, quoting the source file for each date.

appraisal-in-file-not-value.name: Appraisal In File Not Value
appraisal-in-file-not-value.description: Index the appraisal PDF folder: report present, report date, invoice, AOA, and printed appraisal conditions as text. Do not give a value opinion.

title-routing.name: Title Routing
title-routing.description: Index the title folder: commitment, updates, invoices, and related PDFs. Route names and dates.

insurance-binder-present.name: Insurance Binder Present
insurance-binder-present.description: List HOI binders, dec pages, master policies, and flood policies in their insurance-binder folder.

cd-le-present.name: CD and LE Present
cd-le-present.description: List Loan Estimate and Closing Disclosure versions in their LE/CD folder with issued dates as printed.

suspense-list-as-their-codes.name: Suspense List As Their Codes
suspense-list-as-their-codes.description: List suspense and rereq items from their conditions sheet using their codes and comments only.

wire-fraud-checklist-their-process.name: Wire Fraud Checklist Their Process
wire-fraud-checklist-their-process.description: List whether their written wire-fraud or callback checklist rows are marked as they marked them. Do not send a wire.
